verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show it working with Jira/Linear tickets and being tagged in Slack or Teams threads, so it has first-party workflow-tool touchpoints for two of the three named tools. The evidence does not describe how these connections are set up or how they feed context into sessions, and Google Drive is never mentioned. The Devin MCP server (docs-6) exposes Devin to other agents and is a different capability, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: Google Drive integration, documented setup of the Jira/Slack connectors, evidence that these tools extend Devin's context, a general MCP-client or connector mechanism for other tools, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets
